author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0030369 ICAM-3 receptor activity
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30560

Move annotations to GO:0004888 transmembrane signaling receptor activity and add in P2GO an annotation extension for ICAM3 to specify the receptor in "has input".

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HSPNDoKscT7nJ5tqQCFgkHy54_LcqxtcU0QYrCDOzOE

Impacted groups: 
UniProt 3

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None.


Thanks.
